channel.title: The Gambia v. Myanmar — ICJ Hearings
channel.copyright: United Nations / International Court of Justice
channel.description: Complete audio of the public hearings before the International Court of Justice in the case concerning Application of the Convention on the Prevention and Punishment of the Crime of Genocide (The Gambia v. Myanmar), with 11 States intervening. Recordings are the English audio from UN Web TV, presented in chronological order of sitting. Long stretches of silence — before sittings open, during recesses, and after they close — have been removed.
channel.itunes:summary: Complete English audio of the ICJ public hearings in The Gambia v. Myanmar, in chronological order.
channel.itunes:author: International Court of Justice
